name: Old Man Hanasaka
source:
"You mustn't jest like that, or else oni and snakes will come."

From the tale "Hanasaka Jii-san."

An old man living in a small village. A gentle, kindly old man, he was never blessed with children, but he lives a quiet life together with his good-natured wife. 

[From [url=https://adabanaitan.com/en/]ANIPLEX.EXE[/url]]
